subject: Short pilot: smoothing runway and top-up options (hour-bank vs burst pack)
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearmap.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Anya Petrova <anya@clearmap.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — 2 week pilot extension and surge for model tuning

Jonas —

Thanks again for the run we did last month. We hit a snag with integration delays on our end and the model tuning pushed past our scheduled demo window. The product team is asking for an extra 10 business days to finish a second eval sweep.

Can Redwood do a short extension (10 business days) and give us a small burst allowance for a final tuning burst? Ideally we want something that doesn’t commit us to a larger term — this is purely to finish validation.

Open to paying for the extra usage — just want a simple structure. Two ideas on our side:
- Pay-as-you-go top-up purchase that expires after 30 days
- A small hour-bank (X hours) that our engineers can use for bursts

Would appreciate a quick proposal today if possible — we’re trying to lock timing for the demo on Aug 4.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of ML, ClearMap AI
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearmap.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 2 week pilot extension and surge for model tuning

Sanjay —

Thanks for the context. We can definitely support a short extension and two alternative structures that balance flexibility and unit economics:

Option A — 10-business-day extension + 100k token burst pack
- One-time top-up invoice for a 100k token burst (usable over 30 days)
- No change to existing timebox dates aside from the +10 business days
- Burst pack priced at our standard paygo tier with a 10% short-term surcharge to cover priority capacity
- No cap on per-request concurrency but subject to fair-use during priority window

Option B — 10-business-day extension + hour-bank (reserved ops hours)
- Create an hour-bank of 24 GPU-hours reserved for ClearMap within the extended window
- Hour-bank is pre-purchased and can be consumed by any dev activity (tuning, tests)
- Pricing = discounted reserved rate (roughly 18% below paygo) but requires commitment to the block
- We’ll set an engineering contact for prioritization during those hours

Operational notes: we’ll include an addendum (attached draft) and a one-page consumption estimate (attached). If you prefer, we can also offer a small blended option: 12 GPU-hours + 40k token burst for a single invoice.

Kimberly — can you quickly sanity-check pricing for the blended option and confirm SLA for priority handling during the extended window?

If that works, I’ll send a formal addendum and a DocuSign link today so you can sign before your demo.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearmap.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 2 week pilot extension and surge for model tuning

Jonas / Sanjay —

Quick price sanity check from finance/ops:
- 100k token burst pack (30d expiry): $1,900 (paygo+10% surcharge)
- 24 GPU-hour bank (reserved within window): $4,500 (approx 18% discount vs paygo)
- Blended: 12 GPU-hours + 40k token burst: $2,700

Priority handling SLA: engineering will triage bank-hour requests within 2 business hours and provide a dedicated escalation channel for the duration of the reserved hours. That applies to Option B and the blended option.

Attachments: pilot-addendum-draft.pdf (addendum language), usage-estimates.xlsx (consumption scenarios).

Jonas — I’d recommend the blended option for ClearMap if Sanjay wants both flexibility and a lower invoice than pure hour-bank. It’s easier to sign and keeps spend predictable.

— Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearmap.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Anya Petrova <anya@clearmap.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-21T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 2 week pilot extension and surge for model tuning

Team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the blended option looks like the right balance. A few quick clarifications before we sign:
1) Can the 30-day expiry on the burst be extended by mutual agreement if we need a rollover?
2) If we consume fewer than 12 GPU-hours, can the remainder be credited toward paygo within 60 days?
3) For the priority SLA — please confirm the channel (Slack or PagerDuty) and the single point engineer contact for the window.

If those three items are OK we’ll sign the addendum today and push the demo to Aug 6 (gives us breathing room).

Thanks —
Sanjay
Head of ML, ClearMap AI
